_meta.title: Claude Code hook recommendations — stack signal → hook recipe
_meta.notes: Derivative work — distilled from upstream markdown into a structured detection→hook recipe table for ai-kit's recommend-tools scorer. Re-vendor (refresh pin + content) only with explicit user confirmation.

recommendations.name: prettier-format
recommendations.best_for: Auto-format JS/TS on save
recommendations.value: Code stays formatted without thinking about it

recommendations.name: eslint-fix
recommendations.best_for: Auto-fix lint errors on save (JS/TS)

recommendations.name: black-isort
recommendations.best_for: Format Python with black + isort

recommendations.name: ruff
recommendations.best_for: Modern Python lint + format (faster than black/isort)

recommendations.name: gofmt
recommendations.best_for: Standard Go formatting

recommendations.name: rustfmt
recommendations.best_for: Standard Rust formatting

recommendations.name: laravel-pint
recommendations.best_for: PSR-12 PHP formatting via Laravel Pint

recommendations.name: tsc-check
recommendations.best_for: Catch type errors immediately after edits

recommendations.name: mypy-pyright
recommendations.best_for: Python type checking

recommendations.name: block-env-edits
recommendations.best_for: Prevent accidental edits to .env / secrets files
recommendations.value: Stops secret leakage and credential corruption

recommendations.name: block-lockfile-edits
recommendations.best_for: Prevent direct edits to lock files (package manager owns them)

recommendations.name: jest-related
recommendations.best_for: Run related Jest tests after a change

recommendations.name: pytest-related
recommendations.best_for: Run pytest on changed files

recommendations.name: vitest-related
recommendations.best_for: Run Vitest on changed files

recommendations.name: permission-prompt-alert
recommendations.best_for: Sound/desktop alert when Claude requests permission (multitasking workflows)

recommendations.name: idle-prompt-alert
recommendations.best_for: Alert when Claude is idle waiting for input

recommendations.name: phpstan
recommendations.best_for: Static analysis on PHP edits (vanilla or larastan for Laravel)
recommendations.value: Catches type errors and dead code before tests run.

recommendations.name: cargo-clippy
recommendations.best_for: Rust lint on edit — idiomatic suggestions + correctness checks

recommendations.name: swift-format
recommendations.best_for: Apple swift-format on Swift edits

recommendations.name: dart-format
recommendations.best_for: Dart/Flutter format on edit

recommendations.name: commitlint
recommendations.best_for: Enforce Conventional Commits on git commit
recommendations.value: Blocks malformed commit messages before they land in history.

recommendations.name: gitleaks-scan
recommendations.best_for: Block secret strings being written to disk (API keys, tokens, private keys)
recommendations.value: Last-line defence — catches secrets the developer pastes by accident.

recommendations.name: branch-guard
recommendations.best_for: Warn or block edits when checked out on protected branches (main/master)
recommendations.value: Stops accidental direct-to-main edits during agent-driven work.

recommendations.name: large-diff-warn
recommendations.best_for: Surface a warning when a single edit exceeds a configurable LOC threshold
recommendations.value: Discourages sprawling agent edits — nudges toward surgical diffs.

recommendations.name: pre-commit-run
recommendations.best_for: Run the project's pre-commit framework on changed files
recommendations.value: Reuses the team's existing hook config instead of duplicating per-tool entries.
